Designing a local-first bookmark system · GPT-5 · Mock

How should I design bookmarks that survive DOM changes?

Anchor to stable identifiers

Store a conversation ID plus a stable message ID. When the message list rerenders, resolve by ID first; fall back to turn index, role and a text hash.

Storage shape

{
  "conversationId": "conv-1",
  "messageId": "msg-9",
  "messageIndex": 4,
  "preview": "Anchor to stable identifiers..."
}
  • Keep previews short; do not duplicate entire conversations.
  • Make jumps idempotent.
  • Show an orphaned state when the conversation is gone.

This works for bookmarks, notes and the minimap outline alike.

What about note highlights?

Use the CSS Custom Highlight API

Register ranges in CSS.highlights instead of wrapping text nodes. Highlights survive ChatGPT's React rerenders and never mutate the message DOM.

Steps

  1. Resolve the anchor text within the message element.
  2. Create a Range for each match.
  3. Register it in a named Highlight.

If the DOM structure changes, drop the highlight and retry on the next reconcile pass.
